0022600163.text: The Bulls (1-5, 14th in the East, 4 games back in the Central) are on a four-game losing streak and have gone 1-3 on the road, while the 76ers (5-1, 1st in the Atlantic, 2nd in the East) have won their last two. Chicago is without Dailyn Swain (back soreness) and Nic Claxton (hamstring), and Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Bulls won the 2025-26 series 2-1, but the most recent meeting, on March 25, 2026 in Philadelphia, ended with the 76ers winning 157-137.
